Description: Ensure the code adheres to security standards and guidelines.
Why: Protects against vulnerabilities and potential breaches.
Comments: Comprehensive security implementation with Helmet.js, rate limiting, CSRF protection, and input sanitization. However, 12 dependency vulnerabilities found (5 server, 7 client) including 1 high severity. Must update dependencies before production.

Description: Check if the code is easy to read and understand.
Comments: Well-structured code with extensive JSDoc comments and consistent naming. Some components are very large (e.g., SurgicalGuideReportView.vue - 3730 lines) and should be refactored into smaller components.

Description: Look for ways to improve code efficiency.
Why: Ensures faster execution and better resource usage.
Comments: Good performance optimizations: connection pooling, query optimization, Casbin caching, Prometheus metrics. Missing: result caching (Redis), bundle size optimization, and some components could benefit from code splitting.

Description: Verify proper error catching and handling throughout the code.
Why: Prevents crashes and improves user experience.
Comments: Excellent error handling: centralized error handler, 79 try-catch blocks in server, 85 in client, comprehensive error logging with context. Minor improvements: add retry logic for transient failures and Vue error boundaries.

Description: Ensure sufficient unit and integration tests exist.
Comments: CRITICAL: Test coverage is only 4.33% (statements) and 2.32% (branches). 11 test files exist but most code is untested. 1 test is failing. Must increase coverage to 80%+ for critical paths before production.

Why: Helps future developers understand the logic.
Comments: Excellent documentation: comprehensive VitePress docs, extensive JSDoc comments, API documentation, architecture docs, security guides, deployment docs. Minor: add more inline comments for complex logic.

Description: Check for unnecessary or outdated dependencies.
Why: Reduces bloat and potential security risks.
Comments: 12 vulnerabilities found: 5 in server (2 moderate), 7 in client (1 high, 6 moderate). Must update: express, js-yaml, validator, glob, vite/esbuild. Run npm audit fix and update critical dependencies immediately.

Score: Ensures scalable and maintainable code design.
column8: Well-designed architecture: clear separation of concerns, layered structure, proper middleware stack, service abstraction. Main issue: some components are too large and should be refactored.

Comments: ESLint and Prettier configured. Code appears consistently formatted. Missing: pre-commit hooks (Husky), verify ESLint runs in CI/CD, add .editorconfig.

Description: Ensure logs are meaningful and not excessive.
Why: Helps debugging without cluttering logging history.
Comments: Excellent logging: structured logging (Winston/Pino), proper log levels, request IDs, contextual information, file logging, audit trails. Minor: configure log rotation, consider centralized log aggregation.
